steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an actual 2D game animation key drawing. Edit ONLY the UPPER IVORY FLOWER PETALS of the supplied sprite to show a fully CLOSED adult flower bud. Preserve the exact supplied composition, camera, zoom, sprite placement, base footprint, painted shading, dark teal outline weight, and transparent empty margins. The complete lower leaf rosette, green curled side tendrils and ALL mechanical parts must remain unchanged and in exactly the same locations: the front wooden collar, both S-curved wooden front links and all FOUR complete round gold brass hinge plates, both long outer wooden braces, their green vine lashings, and the left winch. Do NOT redraw, move, scale, deform, crop, remove or simplify those mechanical parts or lower leaves.
Close the SAME four existing ivory/mint petals inward: front left and right petals meet along an S-shaped center seam and cover the seeds and sprout completely, rear left and right pointed petals fold behind them and show their two distinct folded tips. The closed shape must visibly belong to this exact flower, retain the fleshy layered mint undersides and ivory highlights and preserve petal identity. Not a smooth single onion, not a new plant. The closed adult bud is centered above the collar at the same bottom attachment, with its tip only slightly higher than the current rear petal tips. Coherent one-piece solid drawing with clean overlaps and no gaps at the collar. No effect, labels, grid, background, shadows or extra objects. Single complete isolated sprite, transparent background, full uncropped base and hardware. Keep output square and retain the reference's relative scale and placement exactly.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE actual 2D sprite animation key drawing by editing image 1. Image 1 is the locked LARGE CLOSED grown pose. Image 2 is the smaller level-2 starting design for context only. Make the MIDDLE CLOSED HOLD after the first growth pulse, before the second. Preserve the exact square canvas, camera, common scale, bottom anchor, large transparent margins, lighting, brushwork and dark teal outline thickness of image 1. Keep the entire basal leaf rosette and both curled green side tendrils EXACTLY the same width, shapes, positions and colors as image 1. Do not shrink or move the whole sprite. It must remain grounded in exactly the same place.
Change the UPPER flower to a younger closed bud, approximately 84% of image 1's closed bud height and 88% of its width, attached slightly lower, its upper tip lower by about one brass-disc diameter. The SAME four folded petals keep their anatomy: the two rear pointed folded tips, ivory front left and right petals meeting along the same S-shaped center seam, with mint lower shading. Seeds and seedling remain hidden. Do not change it to a plain smooth onion. This is intentional body growth, the leaf base does not change size.
The adult wooden mechanism is partway through emerging from BEHIND the basal leaves: the SAME two full-length S-shaped front wooden links rotate to a more upright, inward-folded position alongside the lower sides of the smaller bud. Their lower ends and the front collar are still OCCLUDED by the basal leaves because the folded assembly is lower. Show their round gold upper pivot plates completely, centered on the wood joints. Expose the lower pivot plates only where not hidden by leaves. The brass plates retain EXACTLY the same diameter and solid circular shape as image 1. The two long wooden braces fold inward behind the flower so most of their full lengths are occluded by the bud, with only short glimpses of wood and green lashings beside it. The LEFT winch is partly visible behind the left leaves, at the same physical diameter as image 1. Full rigid components are hidden, NOT scaled smaller, shortened, melted, faded or broken. Distinguish solid brown wood, gold metal discs and green vine lashings clearly with clean coherent material edges. No floating hardware, duplicated outlines or gaps through the flower. Keep the lower leaves unchanged and do not add new parts or ornament.
Single complete uncropped sprite, genuine transparent background. No text, labels, ground shadow, grid, effects, sparkles, glow or extra objects. Image 1's absolute base position and base size are invariants.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE actual closed small key pose for a 2D sprite growth animation. Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET and must lock the full composition and basal leaves. Image 2 is a supporting drawing of the same flower's fully grown closed pose, ONLY to specify how its four petals fold and meet along the S-shaped seam. Do not import image 2's mechanical supports into this early pose.
In image 1, edit ONLY the main upper ivory flower: the same front left and right ivory/mint petals fold inward and tuck down around the seeds, and the rear two petal tips fold behind them. All three golden seeds and the green seedling are completely concealed inside. The new compact closed bud is about 74% of image 2's upper bud height, with the same folded petal anatomy, fleshy mint underside, ivory highlights and S-shaped meeting seam. Relative to image 1's 512 square logical canvas, the bud stays centered at x256, attached at y397, its top near y220, width approximately195. This is the tightly CLUMPED SMALL HOLD before either growth pulse. Not a plain single onion, not a new plant. No wood, gold joints or winch visible yet: any adult hardware is still fully hidden behind the fixed leaves and bud.
Keep EVERY basal leaf and both curled green side tendrils EXACTLY the same as image 1: same positions, outlines, color, size and lower rosette width. Keep the exact same square framing, relative sprite scale, transparent margins, center x, ground baseline and viewing angle. Do not make the whole sprite smaller, do not shrink the lower leaves, do not auto-fit the new shorter plant to the canvas. The space above the now shorter bud remains empty. Match the reference's polished hand-painted game art, shading and dark teal outline weight exactly. One complete isolated sprite, genuine transparent background, no labels, no effects, no ground shadow, no particles or extra objects.

Precise object edit of this 2D sprite keyframe. Keep the entire lower leaf rosette and green curled side tendrils PIXEL-ALIGNED and visually unchanged. Keep the square canvas, relative scale of the lower leaves, root x position, bottom baseline and all transparent margins unchanged. ONLY REDRAW THE UPPER CLOSED IVORY FLOWER MUCH SHORTER AND MORE COMPACT. Its current bud is far too tall. Reduce the bud's height by FORTY PERCENT while keeping its bottom attached at exactly the current point between the basal leaves. The top of the new short bud is MUCH LOWER down the canvas, so there is a much larger area of empty transparent space above it. Do NOT move or zoom the whole plant to fill that space. Width of the bud becomes about EIGHTY PERCENT of its current width. A short squat tightly tucked folded blossom like a fist, visibly MUCH smaller than the current tall teardrop. Preserve the SAME four ivory/mint petal identities: two short rear folded tips behind the left and right front petal folds, same S-shaped central meeting seam, dark teal outlines, ivory highlights, mint shading and painted texture. Short rounded tucked petals, not stretched tall. Seeds and sprout remain completely concealed. No mechanism, wood, brass, winch, effects or new objects. Preserve the original lower leaves perfectly. This is the SMALL CLUMPED HOLD key pose for animation, clearly compressed, with deliberately huge empty space above it. Genuine transparent background, single complete uncropped sprite.

Precise object edit for one actual 2D sprite keyframe. Image 1 is the edit target and locked level-2 OPEN start. Image 2 is the final compact CLOSED destination for this same flower. Draw the halfway CLOSING pose between them, not the fully closed pose. Preserve exactly image 1's square canvas, root/bottom position, relative scale, transparent padding, painting style and dark teal outline weight. Every basal leaf and both curled green side tendrils stay exactly unchanged in shape, size and position from image 1. Do not zoom, reframe, auto-fit or scale the whole plant.
Only change the upper ivory flower: its SAME two front petals fold inward and tuck DOWN, narrowing the middle opening to a slim slit. The upper tips of the two rear petals fold inward and lower. The flower is visibly partway from the tall open bowl in image 1 to the low compact closed fist in image 2. The upper flower becomes somewhat shorter and narrower, but the fixed basal rosette does NOT shrink. One glimpse of the golden seed and the tucked green sprout remains in the narrow center opening, which is almost covered. The petal identities, ivory front faces, mint undersides, coherent folding contours and S-curved central edge must connect naturally to image 2. No disconnected or duplicated petal tips. No wood, brass, mechanism, winch or other objects yet. Full uncropped sprite with the lower leaves unchanged, genuine transparent background, no labels, no effects or ground shadow.

Precise object edit for ONE 2D game animation key drawing. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: fully grown CLOSED bud with deployed mechanism. Image 2 is the locked OPEN adult destination. Draw the opening transition approximately HALFWAY between them. This must be a different pose from both, still mostly closed with a narrow upper gap. Preserve image 1's exact square framing, camera, relative scale, center, bottom anchor and transparent margins. The complete lower leaf rosette and both green curled tendrils remain unchanged in shape, size and positions. All mechanical components remain EXACTLY as in image 1: same two S-curved wooden front links, FOUR complete round gold brass discs centered on their wooden ends, two long outer wooden braces, green vine lashings, front wooden collar, single left winch. Do not change their size, lengths, angles, locations, boundaries or number. Edit ONLY the upper flower petals and what is revealed inside them.
The same four ivory/mint petals start to UNFURL. Front left and right petal upper edges begin curling OUTWARD, opening a small vertical V gap only in the upper central third; the lower halves are still cupped together around the S-shaped center seam. The two rear folded tips begin separating slightly to left and right but remain closer together and more upright than the destination. Through the narrow gap show the partly revealed top of the golden seeds and a small tucked green two-leaf sprout just starting to rise. The seeds and sprout are much MORE CONCEALED than image 2. Maintain the same flower volume, fleshy mint undersides, ivory highlights and clear dark teal outline as image 1. This is a coherent local change in the existing petals, not a new different flower, not a tiny flower, not a fully open adult. No disconnected pieces, doubled edges or see-through outlines. One full uncropped isolated painted sprite on genuine transparent background. No words, effects, ground shadow, grid or new objects.
